Dear leamer,
We are happy that you have chosen a vocational course like 'Cutting Tailoring
and Dress Making'.
You all know that today's world is a world of fashion. We all like to make or
get made new dresses in order to look attractive. Friends, garment construction
is an art and one can adopt it as a profession after becoming skillful in it. From
this angle, this course will prove beneficial for you.
In the present
course the various
aspects of garment
construction
have been
discussed in detail - how to buy cloth suitable to the personality, how to take
body measurements, htnr to cut the cloth and stitch it and the various ways of
making the garment look attractive.
In this course, there are two modules to study. Make full use of this art in your
life.
With best wishes,
